description: Kinkerstraat 1886-1893 Neo-Renaissance fronts (49-53, 66-76, 65-69): brown brick banded with white speklagen (a sill course and an impost course on every storey), segmental and round-headed windows under white blocked arches, stepped or pointed gables with an attic light

step-gable.note: 49-63 pands 1-2, 65-87 pands 1-2: tall stepped gables, top 3.5-4 m over the cornice

wall-dormer.note: 56-84 236441 (Kinkerstraat 62 and 60), strip 2023-01-10 at 40 px/m: one brick wall dormer over the cornice per house, about 1.9 m wide with its stone cheeks, a 2-light window, body about 2.2 m to a peaked brick top about 0.9 m high; drawn as a pointed dormer in the wall colour (the stone cheek scrolls and coping are not drawn)

stone-dormer.note: 56-84 236325 (Kinkerstraat 66), strip 2023-01-10 at 40 px/m: one white stone dormer about 1.45 m wide over the cornice, a single light under a pointed top about 0.9 m high, the next house's step gable beside it

roof.evidence: strip 2024-11-29 kinker-49-63 pands 1-4: between the gables only sky and the dormer over the cornice; the 3DBAG attic stood as a slate block there

rhythm.identicalBays: storeys alternate segmental and round heads (the kit draws segmental on every storey)
rhythm.roofline: stepped or pointed gables over carved cornices
schemaLimits: radiating white voussoirs (sunburst arches) are drawn as blocked arches (springers, two voussoirs, keystone)
white tympana are drawn on every head storey (windowHead.tympanum); on the photo the top storey's heads are glazed
speklagen are evenly spaced every 14 courses (0.77 m, the photo median); on the photo they also step around the arch springers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-29 pands 1-4 (zoom): white speklagen bands, sunburst arches, stepped/pointed gables
strip.jpg 2024-11-29 pands 3-5: banded fronts with gables; cluster-street-types C12

notes: Palette: strip medians from scripts/block-face/palette-from-strip.ts (staging/street-types/kinkerstraat/palette.json) (median of 9 exemplar pands, sunlit 2024-11-29 strips).
